title: Cross-Lingual Mental Health Ontologies for Indian Languages: Bridging Patient Expression and Clinical Understanding through Explainable AI and Human-in-the-Loop Validation

bias_targets.methodology: Constructing a cross-lingual graph-based ontology that maps culturally specific idioms of mental distress to standardized Western clinical concepts, evaluated for cultural validity through human-in-the-loop validation by cultural experts, anthropologists, and community feedback.

Building a multilingual corpus of patient narratives in low-resource Indian languages (including code-mixed and dialectal variations) and evaluating cross-lingual semantic alignment using multilingual LLMs and native speaker linguistic validation.
